create_ALPGMM: create an ALPGMM instance with task space min and max boundary vectors
update_ALPGMM_with_task_reward: update the ALPGMM model with a new task vector and its reward value
sample_task_from_ALPGMM: sample a new task from the ALPGMM using ALP-weighted Gaussian mixture or random exploration
compute_alp_with_EmpiricalALPComputer: compute the absolute learning progress for a task and reward pair using nearest neighbor lookup
proportional_choice_select_index: select an index proportionally from a value array with optional epsilon random fallback
